en.title: Damp Wingbeats and the Inverting Silence
en.premise: After moving into an old estate inherited from relatives, the protagonist finds themselves covering their ears against the eerie cries of migratory birds that arrive every autumn. An old mirror in the house reflects the world with a delay of several seconds, and within that 'lag,' something that shouldn't be there begins to manifest. As the boundary between the reflection and reality blurs, the house becomes thick with the scent of wet feathers and mud.

zh.title: 潮湿的振翅声与反转的寂静
zh.premise: 搬进亲族继承的旧宅后，主人公不得不时刻忍受每年秋天都会响起的、那诡异的候鸟鸣叫声。屋内的古镜所映照的世界，竟比现实慢了几秒——而就在那短暂的“延迟”中，某种本不该存在的东西悄然混入其中。随着镜中的自我与现实的界限逐渐模糊，屋内开始弥漫起一股湿漉漉的羽毛与泥土的气味。
